message.content:
LeBron James is an American professional basketball player widely regarded as one of the greatest athletes of all time. Born on December 30, 1984, in Akron, Ohio, he rose to prominence as a high‑school phenom at St. Vincent‑St. Mary High School, where he was named the USA Today High School Player of the Year and the McDonald's All‑American Game MVP.

He entered the NBA directly from high school in 2003, being selected first overall by the Cleveland Cavaliers. LeBron quickly became known for his combination of size, athleticism, court vision, and basketball IQ—an all‑round game that allows him to score, rebound, and distribute at elite levels.

**Career highlights:**

| Year | Team | Achievement |
|------|------|-------------|
| 2003 | Cleveland Cavaliers | NBA Rookie of the Year |
| 2004–2010 | Cleveland Cavaliers | 4× NBA All‑Star, 2× All‑Defensive First Team |
| 2010–2014 | Miami Heat | 2× NBA Champion (2012, 2013), 2× NBA Finals MVP |
| 2014–2018 | Cleveland Cavaliers | NBA Champion (2016), NBA Finals MVP |
| 2018–2023 | Los Angeles Lakers | NBA Champion (2020), NBA Finals MVP |
| 2023–present | Los Angeles Lakers | Continues to play at an elite level |

**Statistical résumé (regular season, as of 2023‑24):**

- Points per game: ~27.0  
- Rebounds per game: ~7.5  
- Assists per game: ~7.4  
- Career NBA championships: 4  
- NBA Finals MVP awards: 4  

Beyond the court, LeBron is known for his philanthropy, most notably the **LeBron James Family Foundation**, which opened the *I Promise School* in Akron—a public school aimed at supporting at‑risk children. He has also built a media empire, producing films and television shows through his company **SpringHill Entertainment**, and has been a vocal advocate on social justice issues.

LeBron’s impact extends into popular culture: he’s a global brand ambassador, has appeared in major advertising campaigns, and has been featured in video games, movies, and music. His legacy is measured not only by his on‑court achievements but also by his influence on the sport’s business, culture, and community outreach.
